scripts.migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply taskflow-db --local --config wrangler.toml
scripts.migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply taskflow-db -e production --config wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -e production
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build && wrangler deploy -e production --dry-run
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run migrate && npm run build
